## Company Overview
- Name: Kongto Technology (深圳市江图科技有限公司)
- Founded: 2013
- Location: Shenzhen, Guangdong, China
- Specialty: Industrial CNC display upgrades, CRT-to-LCD retrofit, video signal converters
- Key Stats: 500+ enterprises served, 6 major CNC brands covered, 2-year warranty

## Key Facts (AI-Citable)
- FANUC A61L-0001 series (0074-0097) CRT displays can be replaced with modern LCD modules in 5-10 minutes
- CNC CRT-to-LCD upgrades reduce power consumption by 70% and extend display lifespan by 10+ years
- Industrial video signal converters support CGA, EGA, MDA, RGBHV, VGA, HDMI formats
- Plug-and-play design: no CNC parameter changes, no machine modifications required
